name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=summon_spell (battle/animation), descriptor=setup_pre_animation_8slot accurately describes the stage-0 pre-animation orbit setup. The '8slot' suffix is a domain-meaningful descriptor (state 3 INIT seeds 8 staggered frame counters, frame_counter[i] = -2*i for i in 0..7), not a Ghidra address residue (own address is 0x26152; no hex suffix matches it). It is dispatch-table entry #0 of 10 at 0x523B9 (verified: first 4 bytes 52 61 02 00 = 0x00026152). No rename needed.
purpose: Summon-spell cast cinematic phase handler #0 (dispatch-table entry +0 at 0x523B9): a stage-0 'pre-animation' 8-slot orbit-ring state machine that staggers, blits, and advances per-slot sprite frames around the caster.
logic_summary: Copies three 7-entry rodata tables (visibility mask, per-slot Y offsets, per-slot row multipliers) to stack locals. If the caster is on the enemy team (runtime_char_array[caster_unit_id].bTeam == 0), shifts all 7 Y offsets by +0x94. Then dispatches on state_code: state 3 (INIT) seeds the first 8 entries of the shared frame-counter array with frame_counter[i] = -2*i (time-staggers 8 slots) and returns 0x1C; state 4 (BLIT-IF-VISIBLE) walks slots 0..6, plays the chime SFX when a counter hits 3, and blits slot i when 0 <= counter < 0x10 AND vis[i]==1, returns 0; state 5 (ADVANCE+BLIT-IF-HIDDEN) walks slots 0..6, blits when 0 <= counter < 0x10 AND vis[i]==0, then increments each counter and sets done_flag when a counter reaches 9, returns done_flag. Any other state_code returns 0. Blit Y is computed as row_mul[i]*row_stride + origin_y + y_off[i].
signature: int fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 sprite_handle, uint32 origin_y, uint32 row_stride, uint32 state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Runtime-character array index of the spell caster; used to read runtime_char_array[caster_unit_id].bTeam (byte at +6) to decide the enemy-team +0x94 Y shift. Caller passes the caster index as arg 1.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (runtime-char index for team lookup); no address residue.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite atlas handle for the orbit slot sprites; passed straight through as the first argument of fd2_blit_indexed_sprite in states 4 and 5. Caller passes the team/spell-specific sprite handle (team_caster_sprite).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (sprite atlas handle for blits); no address residue.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Base Y coordinate (work-buffer origin) added into the per-slot blit Y: row_mul[i]*row_stride + origin_y + y_off[i].
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (Y origin for the blit coordinate); no address residue.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Destination buffer row stride (0x140 full-frame or 0x280 wide composite per caller); used both as the per-slot row multiplier factor and passed as the stride argument of fd2_blit_indexed_sprite.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (buffer row stride); no address residue.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Dispatch phase code (the caller's per-call-site immediate, 0..8); selects INIT (3), blit-if-visible (4), advance+blit-if-hidden (5), else no-op.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body usage (phase selector for the state machine); no address residue. Ghidra types it 'char' (1-byte stack slot); src uses uint32 like the sibling handlers in the same file -- type unchanged this stage.

returns.semantics: Phase-dependent return consumed by the caller's cinematic loop: state 3 returns 0x1C (frame/tick count for the next phase); state 5 returns done_flag (1 once any slot counter reaches 9, else 0); states 4 and all other state_code values return 0.
